records.en: So what am I even fighting for?

records.en_auxiliary: What are you talking about? What happened, Hinako?

records.en_auxiliary: So you're saying you'll never be able to dance again?

で、でも、まだ何か手段があるかもしれない！

records.en_auxiliary: Th-there must be something we can do!
records.en: Th-There must be something we can do!

records.en_auxiliary: As long as there's still a sliver of hope your leg will heal...

更紗にはわからないよ……！

records.en_auxiliary: You don't get it, do you?!
